description: Lateral alias/column precedence in projections (swaps, unbacked aliases, group-key vs aggregate alias) and LEFT JOIN LATERAL null-extension vs comma/CROSS/INNER forms. Converted 1:1 from query/LateralAliasColumnPrecedenceTest and LateralLeftJoinNullExtendTest (both now retired). The INNER JOIN LATERAL cell skips snowflake per the original assumption (aborts live with an internal-error incident).
